text: INTERPRETER (lang-forms LF-2, parser desugar plus checker/infer diagnostics only): `if let PAT = EXPR { A } else B` and `else if let` chains now parse where they were an E0000 parse error; they desugar to `match EXPR { PAT => { A }, __iflet_N => B }` (B an empty block without `else`), a shape every engine already ran, so what an already-valid program computes is unchanged. A no-else `if let` with a non-unit body is E0102 naming the `if let`; an irrefutable `if let` pattern is W0004 naming the `if let`. fmt prints the form back. The CS3-5 parse help for `if let` is removed.
